title: Two Isosceles Triangles, One Mystery Angle | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
We only know one angle, but two isosceles triangles hide the answer! Vantee chases the top angle with a letter, then shows a second way using the outside angle of a triangle.
You'll also see why each wrong choice is tempting, and get a new angle to chase yourself.
